entries.title: Luke 5:6
segments: V. 6. Their net brake-Began to tear.

entries.title: Luke 5:8
segments: V. 8. Depart from me, for I am a sinful man-And therefore not worthy to be in thy presence.

entries.title: Luke 5:11
segments: V. 11. They forsook all and followed him-They had followed him before,
, but not so as to forsake all.  Till now, they wrought at their ordinary calling.

entries.title: Luke 5:16
segments: V. 16. He withdrew-The expression in the original implies, that he did so frequently.

entries.title: Luke 5:17
segments:
V. 17. Sitting by-As being more honourable than the bulk of the congregation, who stood. 
 
  And the power of the Lord was present to heal them-To heal the sickness of their souls, as well as all bodily diseases.

entries.title: Luke 5:19
segments: V. 19. Not being able to bring him in through the multitude, they went round about by a back passage, and going up the stairs on the outside, they came upon the flat-roofed house, and let him down through the trap door, such as was on the top of most of the Jewish houses: doubtless, with such circumspection as the circumstances plainly required.

entries.title: Luke 5:26
segments: V. 26. We have seen strange things to. day-Sins forgiven, miracles wrought.

entries.title: Luke 5:28
segments: V. 28. Leaving all-His business and gain.

entries.title: Luke 5:29
segments: V. 29. And Levi made him a great entertainment-It was necessarily great, because of the great number of guests.

entries.title: Luke 5:34
segments: V. 34. Can ye make-That is, is it proper to make men fast and mourn, during a festival solemnity?

entries.title: Luke 5:36
segments: V. 36. He spake also a parable-Taken from clothes and wine; therefore peculiarly proper at a feast.

entries.title: Luke 5:39
segments: V. 39. And no man having drunk old wine-And beside, men are not wont to be immediately freed from old prejudices.
